name: display-options-popover
title: Display options popover
description: The Display button of a list view: choose layout, grouping, ordering and which properties show, with changes applying at once and a reset.
docs: Pass layouts ({ id, label, icon }), groupings and orderings ({ id, label }), properties ({ id, label, visible }) and the current value ({ layout, grouping, ordering, direction, properties }) with onValueChange, or a defaultValue to let the popover keep it. Layout is a group of small icon tiles (a list, board, table, grid or calendar id draws its own icon, and icon replaces it); grouping and ordering use the house select, with a button that turns the ordering round; properties are chips that show and hide fields, and value.properties holds the ids that show. Every change applies at once through onValueChange(next). The button counts how many of the four settings differ from the defaults (ordering counts once, whether the field or the direction moved) and is named 'Display, 2 changed'; the defaults are the first layout, grouping and ordering, ascending, and the properties not marked visible: false, or pass defaults. Reset puts the defaults back, calls onReset and says 'Back to the defaults' in a polite live region. A saved value that names an option that no longer exists falls back to the default for it. The panel keeps inside the window and scrolls inside itself at 320 pixels. trigger replaces the button, open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the panel, DisplayOptionsPanel is the inside on its own for a sheet on a phone, and labels translates every word.
